tagline: Organic, fermented skincare — nature as it is
descriptor: ENS Korea, maker of the WHAMISA brand: organic-certified skincare, hair and body care built on a 25-day two-step fermentation, across seven plant collections
about: WHAMISA is a Korean organic skincare brand owned and made by ENS Korea Co., Ltd. (ENSBEAUTY Group). The company selects organically grown plants and, through a long fermentation, works to bring out their active properties — an approach it sums up as "nature as it is".

At the centre of the brand is a two-step fermentation the company says takes about 25 days, with humidity, temperature and the fermentation itself monitored to the end. WHAMISA states it was the first to isolate the kimchi-derived lactobacillus strain Lactiplantibacillus plantarum ENS9265, and each collection is built around its own fermented complex.

The range is organized into seven plant collections — Flowers, Cactus, Pear Blossom, Seeds, Algae, Herb and Fruits — covering facial care, sun care, hair and scalp care, and body care. Teranova presents the brand for B2B partners; prices and terms are shared directly, not published.
facts: ENS Korea Co., Ltd. (ENSBEAUTY Group), Seoul, Korea — owner and maker of the WHAMISA brand
Organic and fermentation-based skincare; a proprietary two-step fermentation of about 25 days, per the company
The company states it was first to isolate the kimchi-derived strain Lactiplantibacillus plantarum ENS9265
Brand-stated certifications: COSMOS ORGANIC, vegan, dermatologically tested, and Ecocert functional ingredients
The company states partners in 27 countries and a member status in "1% for the Planet"
channels: Organic and clean-beauty retailers and department stores
Salons, spas and scalp-care specialists (hair line)

lines.name: Organic Flowers
lines.note: The core facial collection, built on the brand's Flower Essential Complex from eight organic flowers: first-step toners and lotions, creams, cleansers, facial oil, eye essence, mist and masks. Several products are waterless, using organic aloe in place of purified water, per the company.

lines.name: Organic Cactus
lines.note: A hydration collection on the Cactus Hydration Complex from Nopal cactus: a bouncy moisture serum, a wrinkle-and-brightening serum, and a PDRN moisture toner pad.

lines.name: Organic Pear Blossom
lines.note: The Flower Radiance Complex line: an essence toner and a mineral (zinc-oxide) sunscreen and sun powder, described by the company as broad-spectrum with no white cast.

lines.name: Organic Seeds — hair & scalp
lines.note: Built on the Seed Vitality Complex from protein-rich seeds — the brand's hair and scalp line. The Green Peas Shampoo Scalp Care contains three KFDA-recognized hair-loss-care ingredients (menthol, salicylic acid, dexpanthenol), per the company; the line also covers oily- and dry-scalp shampoos, a hair treatment, a scalp tonic and body care.

lines.name: Organic Algae
lines.note: The Algae Refreshing Complex from organic kelp: a real-kelp sheet mask, body cleanser and mists.

lines.name: Organic Herb
lines.note: The Planta Relaxing Complex from four herbs: an outdoor spray the company describes as a cosmetic with essential oils that insects avoid, and an olive-leaf mist.

lines.name: Organic Fruits
lines.note: The Fruits Clear Complex, yuja-based: a hydrogel mask, a pore-clear exfoliating pad and a spot treatment.

tech.name: Two-step fermentation
tech.note: The company's signature process: naturally derived ingredients are inoculated with a lactobacillus strain and fermented in two stages, then filtered and sterilized into a fermented filtrate extract. WHAMISA states the cycle takes about 25 days.

tech.name: Organic sourcing and clean formulation
tech.note: The brand states it selects organically grown plants, excludes synthetic ingredients from the planning stage, and uses eco-friendly packaging — recyclable containers, paper tape, soy-ink printing and biodegradable materials.

tech.name: Fermented complexes
tech.note: Each collection carries its own fermented complex — for example Flower Essential, Cactus Hydration, Seed Vitality and Algae Refreshing — presented by the company as the active heart of the line.

formats: Shampoos, hair treatment and scalp tonic
exportNote: The company states that WHAMISA works with partners in 27 countries and is stocked internationally at retailers such as Le Bon Marché and Printemps in Paris, Saks Fifth Avenue in New York and The Korner in Frankfurt, alongside Korean department stores and duty-free. WHAMISA is sold as finished product through a distribution model; the company does not publish fixed prices, and payment and shipping terms are shared with partners through Teranova. The brand also states recognition at the RE.AWARDS 2025, including first-place nominations for the Organic Flowers Foaming Gel and the Organic Pear Blossom Sunscreen.

terms.label: Forms of cooperation
terms.value: Wholesale supply of finished WHAMISA products through a distribution model; the company states it does not work through OEM/ODM. Open to distributors, retailers and specialist stores.

terms.label: Prices and terms
terms.value: Prices are not published. Payment and shipping terms are consistent and shared with partners through Teranova.

terms.label: Certifications
